AdminRolesPanel.explication: One click grants or removes the role immediately; there is nothing to save. <gras>Beta tester</gras> opens the Multi-monument plan, without billing; <gras>Administrator</gras> opens this page, plus the Multi-monument plan.
AdminRolesPanel.listeTronquee: Only the most recent accounts are listed. Role holders always appear, wherever they are in the list.
AdminRolesPanel.socleExplication: Accounts marked ADMIN_USER_IDS get their administration rights from the server configuration: it bootstraps access on a fresh environment and is removed by editing the .env file, then redeploying. You cannot remove your own administration rights; ask another administrator to do it.

AdminStatsPage.description: How many schemes each regional council and each departmental council funds, and how many apply everywhere. Click a row to show their names.
AdminStatsPage.groupeVide: No scheme from this authority in the catalogue.

synchronisation.explication: The eligibility check suggests them, but creating an application will return “Scheme not found”. Run scripts/load_aides_yaml.py again to push them.

AdminStatsPage.filtrer: Filter an area (name, INSEE code, region)…
AdminStatsPage.autresTitre: {{nb}} schemes from a funder with no territorial level

notes.regions: Schemes funded by each regional council, including those it restricts to a few departments. What the Region funds, not what applies in its area: State and Department schemes have their own tabs.
notes.departements: Schemes funded by each departmental council. A zero does not mean a monument in the department is entitled to nothing: it also sees its region’s schemes, the national ones and those of other funders. It means there is a whole Department left to prospect.
notes.autres: Foundations, Europe, patronage: their scope is local without a single euro coming from a local authority. Counting them as Department schemes would be wrong; hiding them would make them disappear from the page.
notes.pied: The four headline figures add up: a scheme is counted only once, at the level that funds it. {{nc}} = the source states neither a rate nor an amount: nothing is inferred, nothing is added up. Schemes withdrawn from the catalogue are neither counted nor listed.
